description: This Java class defines the CohortMembership entity used within the OpenMRS healthcare platform. It models the relationship between a patient and a cohort, including start and end dates, and provides methods for status checks, comparison, and equality. The class is annotated for ORM and auditing purposes and extends a base data class.

classes.name: CohortMembership
classes.description: Represents a patient's membership in a specific cohort with validity period, supporting status checks and comparison operations.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks whether the membership is active on a specified date or today if null.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Provides comparison logic based on voided status, end date, start date, patient ID, and UUID for sorting.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Defines equality based on end date, start date, and patient ID.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on patient ID, end date, and start date.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this cohort membership.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this cohort membership.

methods.name: getCohortMemberId
methods.description: Returns the internal ID of the cohort membership.

methods.name: setCohortMemberId
methods.description: Sets the internal ID of the cohort membership.

methods.name: getCohort
methods.description: Returns the cohort object associated with this membership.

methods.name: setCohort
methods.description: Associates a cohort object with this membership.

methods.name: getPatientId
methods.description: Returns the patient ID linked to this membership.

methods.name: setPatientId
methods.description: Sets the patient ID for this membership.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the membership.

methods.name: setStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the membership.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the membership.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the membership.
